# P5.7.6 Independent Evaluation — Status: `BLOCKED_PENDING_SCENE_DIVERSE_DATA`

**Date:** 16 November 2026. Machine-readable evidence: `phase5_task7_6_status.json` (generated by `scripts/phase5_check_independent_data.py` from a read-only scan of the repository and the local pilot input folder; implementation `pedsafety/phase5/independent_data_status.py`, tests `tests/phase5/test_independent_data_status.py`).

## Finding
No scene-diverse data and no verified annotations are available, so no independent evaluation was performed and none was fabricated (`independent_evaluation_performed: false`, `fabricated_results: false`).

| Requirement | Found | Met |
|---|---|---|
| ≥ 3 independent scene groups processed (Phase 3 → Task 2 → Task 3 → P5.3) | 1 (`pie:video_0004`; two Task 3 runs of the same video; one P5.3 window run labelled `PILOT_DEVELOPMENT_ONLY_NON_INDEPENDENT`) | no |
| per-video annotation XML available locally (≥ 3) | 0 files (`video_0004_annt.xml` is not on this machine) | no |
| verified pedestrian identity mapping and frame/timestamp alignment between annotations and perceived tracks | impossible without annotations | no |
| group-level split manifest (whole groups per partition, purge ≥ the dependency interval) | none (the pilot has one group; no split is created) | no |

Local video files: none. The check is deliberately conservative: even when enough groups and annotation files exist, the status stays blocked until the identity mapping, alignment and the group-level split manifest are verified (tested with synthetic directory trees).

## Consequences
No train / validation / test evaluation, generalisation estimate, cross-scene claim, defensible best-checkpoint selection or statistical comparison with the baselines can be produced. Every P5.7 result is `PILOT_DEVELOPMENT_ONLY_NON_INDEPENDENT` and in-sample. The other P5.7 tasks are not blocked.

## Acquisition requirements (what unblocks this task)
1. Archive the PIE licence / terms for videos, annotations and derived data; write a dataset manifest with archive hashes.
2. Choose a PIE subset with ≥ 3 independent groups (proposal: recording sets, after verifying the set semantics) and acquire the videos and their annotation XML.
3. Run Phase 3 perception (Colab T4) per video, then Phase 4 Task 2 / Task 3 and the P5.3 window generator per video; measure Phase 3 detection / tracking quality against the annotations (Phase 3 Task 4 evaluator).
4. Implement the `ANNOTATED_TARGET` adapter with a verified identity mapping and alignment (never invented), with annotation validity checks.
5. Create and freeze a group-level split manifest (purge ≥ 62 frames between chronological blocks for H = 6, F = 15, s = 3; whole groups per partition).
6. Re-run P5.7.2–P5.7.5 on the training groups (train-only statistics), select checkpoints / hyperparameters on validation groups only, evaluate once on the held-out groups with cluster-bootstrap intervals over tracks and groups.
